channel.title: Geosystems – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: 3D technology opens Georgia Aquarium’s window into the world of sharks
item.dc:creator: Katherine Ji
item.description: A new shark exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta invites guests to experience the wonder of ocean life in ways not possible before, thanks to advanced building and measurement technologies.

item.title: Tech Highlight: AiMaps
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, we’re discussing AiMaps, the new software tool from IDS GeoRadar for IQMaps, offering intelligent cloud processing of GPR data for a faster detection of underground utilities.

item.title: What tomorrow’s surveyors want you to know
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we sat down with students from Oregon State University’s Civil Engineering Geomatics program to explore the changes that are occurring in the surveying profession as the next generation start to enter the workforce.

item.title: Grow your business with monitoring
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Monitoring is a growth market and thus a promising field for surveyors who want to branch out. Surveyors can easily get into simple manual monitoring using their existing surveying knowledge and, as they gain experience, venture into more advanced automated monitoring projects.

item.title: Towards autonomous connected ecosystems
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN TV, Magnus Thibblin, President, Machine Control for Hexagon's Geosystems division explains how the industry is heading on a progressive path from automation toward autonomy.

item.title: The wonder of surveying: Why building the next wonders of the world is our only job
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Watch as President of Hexagon's Geosystems division, Thomas Harring, and Craig Martin, President of Hexagon’s US/Canada Geosystems, present how to empower your workforce and inspire the people who will create the wonders of the future.

item.title: How are scanners shaping the future of AEC and what do leaders need to know?
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Laser scanners are changing the way AEC professionals capture and use data, but what do leaders need to know to get the most out of this technology?

item.title: Hexagon laser scanners are a “game changer” for forensic investigators
item.dc:creator: Edward Morgan
item.description: Featured in the BBC Documentary “Forensics, the Real CSI,” laser scanners by Leica Geosystems (a part of Hexagon) are used by investigators to capture an accurate 3D image of a location in Dudley, West Midlands, England

item.title: Sensor fusion: Its role in smarter cities and construction
item.dc:creator: Burkhard Boeckem
item.description: Because sensors are the foundation for so many intelligent things, we need them to be reliable. This is where sensor fusion comes in.

item.title: Pure Surveying: 200 years as industry innovators
item.dc:creator: Thomas Harring
item.description: Powerful surveying technologies can support your business by overcoming obstacles in the field and helping you to experience and interact with data intuitively.
